duration.text: The German at Dalian University of Foreign Languages is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2763 USD/per year ￥ 19900 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Health Certificate Photocopy of physical examination record. 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program)

requirements.text: 1.Be in good health condition 2.Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3.HSK level 6 or above
